title: Obys — greyscale strip under a viewfinder, the framed one in colour
note: Thumbnails of different shapes (about 130–200px wide) stack in a column with 5px gaps and scroll with the wheel, looping. All of them are greyscale with lowered contrast, except the one between the brackets: it's in full colour and about 1.3× bigger, and its neighbours move apart to make room rather than being covered. Scrolling eases and settles with the current image centred. The brackets are two halves of a lens: a box with bevelled outer corners and a big circular bite out of the inner side, so each half has thick tips and a thin spine. They sit about 430px apart at 130px tall. Worth reusing as a whole: it's the kit's viewfinder-strip block.
